company_name: Hangzhou Deefine Filtration Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides filtration solutions that are applicable in microelectronics but does not directly supply semiconductor components.
summary: Hangzhou Deefine Filtration Technology Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing various filter cartridges, including micron membrane filters and high flow filter cartridges. Their products are utilized in process water and microelectronics applications, focusing on high quality and technical support.
